experiment_data.hypothesis: Cross-lingual correctness direction transfers across languages in Llama 4 Scout (48-layer MoE, W4A16): English-trained linear probes at 13 probed layers (0,4,8,...,44,47) will transfer to 19 non-English languages with AUROC ≥ 0.58 for ≥15/19 languages at best layer, with depth-dependent transfer pattern (shallow→deep ΔAUROC ≥ 5pp). MoE architecture with 17B active params provides architectural contrast to dense Qwen models. Retry of plan_002 with 4 GPUs (single-GPU OOM confirmed by dry-run).
